english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for garlic, especially the bulb used in cooking.

examples.english: Adding some garlic while stir-frying makes it much more fragrant.
examples.traditional: 炒菜嗰陣落啲蒜頭，會香好多。
examples.jyutping: caau2 coi3 go2 zan6 lok6 di1 syun3 tau4 wui5 hoeng1 hou2 do1
